value.answer: Tomorrow in Windsor: mainly cloudy with a 30% chance of showers early on and a risk of a thunderstorm, clearing up by morning. High of 29, feels like 35 with the humidex. Wind picks up late morning, southwest around 40 km/h gusting to 60, so watch for it. That's from Environment Canada's Monday afternoon update.
